name: Thabo Moloi
bio:
Thabo's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, initially drawn in by the raw power and precision engineering he witnessed at a local rally event. His meticulous attention to detail quickly made him an asset, first at a small tuning shop, then catching the eye of Century Motorsport. He is known for his unwavering commitment to ensuring every component and process meets the highest standards. 

Thabo's approach to quality control is deeply rooted in understanding the entire system. He believes identifying potential issues early is crucial, and he's not afraid to challenge established procedures if he sees room for improvement. What sets him apart is his knack for not only spotting defects but also understanding the underlying causes, contributing to long-term solutions and preventing future problems. His loyalty and sharp eye make him a valuable asset to Century Motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly cropped with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Thabo is a lean man of average height, with a focused and intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces when deep in thought.
Insists on double-checking critical components himself, even after they've been inspected by others.
